theorems.name: Submission.cmb_rb_integral_coeff_pairing_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (K : Set (Eucl P)), MeasurableSet K → (∀ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, IntegrableOn (fun x => euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β) K μ) → ∀ (θ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) n) (D : ℝ), Continuous θ → (∀ x, x ∉ K → θ x = 0) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (θ x) ≤ D) → Integrable (fun x => ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate (θ x) β * euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β) μ ∧ |∫ x, ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate (θ x) β * euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β ∂μ| ≤ D * ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, ∫ x in K, |euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β| ∂μ
